source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu / Indian Express
bullets_en: ‘Congress to be wiped out in next LS polls,’ says Mohan Yadav.
US votes in crucial midterms seen as referendum on Trump presidency.
Bihar Assembly serves notice to Anant Singh over plea to expel him.
24 killed in fresh attack in Ukraine, President Zelenskyy seeks US pressure on Russia.
bullets_ur: 'Agley LS intikhabat mein Congress ka safaya ho jaye ga,' Mohan Yadav ka bayan.
US mein ahem midterms ke liye voting, jinhein Trump presidency par referendum samjha ja raha hai.
Bihar Assembly ne Anant Singh ko kharij karne ki darkhwast par notice jari kar diya.
